Grace likes rainy days best. Grace and Mia had great fun there. It takes twenty minutes to get to the chess corner by bike. What's more, her drawing of the cat won a prize.
Grace hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Grace's favorite animal is the dog. The weather was rainy that day. For example, water freezes at zero degrees centigrade under normal conditions.
